kinds.label: Job loss
kinds.blurb: One partner loses their job: stress jumps on the start day and stays raised until the end day.

kinds.label: Financial crisis
kinds.blurb: Money trouble for the household: both partners carry extra daily stress between the start and end days.

kinds.label: Temptation
kinds.blurb: One partner keeps meeting attractive alternatives: more outside encounters, and better matched ones, until the end day.

kinds.label: Intimacy mismatch
kinds.blurb: One partner starts wanting much more or less closeness; the gap wears on affect and the one who wants more may store disappointment each week.

kinds.label: Daily texts
kinds.blurb: One partner sends affection every day: the other stores a small positive memory and feels a little better each day.

kinds.label: Anniversary
kinds.blurb: On the start day and every year after, both partners store a strong positive memory and trust rises.

kinds.label: Date nights
kinds.blurb: Every seventh day both partners store a positive memory of an evening together.

kinds.label: Trait shift
kinds.blurb: One partner's trait moves by the magnitude on the start day (for example 0.3 more neurotic) and stays there.
